DispatchOrder.$comment: list: the section 6 order list; soonest_reset: ready candidates by earliest weekly reset among those with weekly left above 0 (fleet-people-access.md section 8)

FocusSetRequest.$comment: projectIds: a list of project ids in the caller's grants, or "*".

ListMembershipRequest.$comment: At most 1000 ids and one or two lists.

MeReply.$comment: email, name and grantsVersion are null without a person (agent-only stand).

MembershipAnswer.$comment: rows: the ids that are members of the list now.

items.$comment: One people.json entry (email, name, roles, owner, grants); never the service token's client ID.

PeopleSetReply.$comment: people: how many people the list now has.

PeopleSetRequest.$comment: Owner only: the whole people.json list, written atomically and reloaded.

pins.$comment: the person's pinned sidebar sections in their order (app shell); empty when unset

views.$comment: the person's saved list views (P5), in order; system presets live in the app and are not stored

focus.$comment: focused project ids (P6); '-' is no project; empty: every project. Lists and feeds without an explicit project filter use it

focusPresets.$comment: the person's saved focus selections, in order

widths.$comment: column widths in px by column key (P13), e.g. nav, control

rowPins.$comment: pinned row ids by list name, e.g. tasks

list.$comment: the list the view belongs to, e.g. tasks

view.$comment: the view state (packages/view-url View: state, group, project, q, ...)

email.$comment: default: the caller; another person: the owner only

Found.$comment: One found entity; the app opens /<kind>s/<id>.

SearchReply.$comment: Hits of every provider in registry order: tasks (an id starting with the text first, then recently changed first), projects, hosts. Each word of the text narrows the hits.

query.$comment: Free text plus field:value terms (agent, host, state, project), the list search syntax; a provider that cannot apply a term finds nothing.

ViewLinkReply.$comment: For view: url and path; for url: the parsed view.

ViewLinkRequest.$comment: Exactly one of view (a view state to link) or url (a Fleet URL to read back).
